title: Netlify's founder: Early Customers, Achieving PMF, Evolving B2B Strategies & more
description:
I had a chance to interview the founder of Netlify, which is worth over $1.9BN,  In this conversation we spoke about his founding story & the things that led to Netlify's Product Market Fit.
